en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a rural street scene in early 20th-century Sweden. The image shows a dirt road lined with wooden fences, people walking, and a horse-drawn carriage with passengers. The background includes scattered houses and tall telegraph poles. The front is labeled 'Wifsta Timrå.' The reverse side has handwritten text in Swedish, Swedish postage, and addresses in neat script.
